entries.briefTitle: Codex gpt-6-astra: quiet slot with product-timing holds (12:34)

angles.workingTitle: Capability, outcome, and clock — three different facts
angles.thesis: A documented product feature is not proof it improved outcomes, and neither is proof it belongs in today’s Field Brief window.
angles.doNotOverclaim: STAY_QUIET slot — zero new ranks. Routed v1.5.0 tuning is a pending progress candidate on the existing card only after release-clock verification; do not invent a second Routed rank or adopt README accuracy gains as reproduced results.

angles.workingTitle: Historical eval coverage is not better production behavior
angles.thesis: Scoring past observations can close coverage gaps; it does not by itself show agents behaved better in production.
angles.doNotOverclaim: Langfuse historical-evaluation announcement is day-dated Sep 7 but HELD for this 12:34 cutoff (no verified intraday time). Do not treat it as a new Industry rank or claim measured production lift.

angles.workingTitle: Session expiry is not task failure
angles.thesis: MCP/session lifecycle events (idle expiry, reconnect, admission refusal) must stay separable from tool execution and task outcome in agent analytics.
angles.doNotOverclaim: mcp 2.2.0 is an infrastructure WATCH, not an analytics product rank. Do not claim it eliminates SSRF/replay/exhaustion risks or that token-resource validation is universally enabled.

entries.briefTitle: Codex gpt-6-astra: Inficy beta, OR-Clarify/InterOPT, Enoki (06:34 catch-up)

angles.workingTitle: An intact agent claim is not an observed action
angles.thesis: Runtime-observed vs agent-reported must stay labeled; integrity ≠ correctness.
angles.doNotOverclaim: Do not treat Inficy certification as proof of correct/safe/complete action; open beta / audit maturity unresolved.

angles.workingTitle: Asked is not recovered; recovered is not ready
angles.thesis: Separate question asked, requirement recovered, and readiness declared; compare at fixed question budget.
angles.doNotOverclaim: Gap ledger is Open→Asked not verified-resolved; no downstream solver success established.

angles.workingTitle: Point at the bad fragment, not just "hallucination"
angles.thesis: Factual checks can project to answer spans as a reviewer aid, with explicit unexamined remainder.
angles.doNotOverclaim: Span Coverage F1 ≠ exact-boundary accuracy; not agent root-cause localization.
